Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up: jointly-hosted webinar with CloudPort + EdgeLabs booked for Jun 8. Need final run-of-show, speaker 1-liners, demo failover plan, and swag customs cleared. Who can take marketplace listing?

Ethan (Events): I9ll own stage ops. Rehearsal slot Jun 7 14:00 PT. Room has limited Wi-Fi; cellular fallback required. Slides due Jun 5 EOD.

Sofia (Field Marketing): Landing page copy due Jun 4. Need headshots and 1-line blurbs from speakers by then. Also request: co-branded hero image (svg) and a 10s demo GIF.

Raj (Solutions): Demo plan: primary = marketplace deploy -> Redwood Hosted API. Fallback = EdgeLabs device local inference. I'll produce a small health-check curl and a fallback indicator. Suggested quick test:
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/ping -d '{"test":"ok"}' | jq -r '.status'

Tom (Logistics): Swag: 120 promo kits. Shipping manifest: EL-450-US. ETA to venue dock Jun 7 06:30. Need two volunteer names for pickup signature. Also confirm customs CN22 for EU partners.

Maya (Partnerships): Marketplace owner: @Sofia + @Raj for deploy links. CloudPort asked for SKU mapping by Jun 3.

BrandBot: Reminder created: "CloudPort x EdgeLabs webinar rehearsal" scheduled Jun 7 14:00 PT. Invite sent.

Ethan (Events): I'll post a simple cue sheet and a 3-point handoff: (1) CloudPort ends screenshare, (2) host counts down, (3) EdgeLabs starts. Visual overlay: "EdgeLabs GO".

Sofia (Field Marketing): Volunteers: I can send two contractors for swag pickup. Will DM Tom names. Also planning a 15s social clip post-demo, need partner sign-off.

Maya (Partnerships): Action items: Sofia logos+copy by Jun 4, Raj demo GIF + smoke test by Jun 3, Tom finalize manifest+volunteers by Jun 2, Ethan post cue-sheet by Jun 6. Flag gaps now.
